about: Risk tiers by path (#1259 step 2), read by scripts/tier.mjs (pnpm tier). A file takes the highest tier of the rules whose paths match it (and whose except does not), light when none does; a change takes the highest tier of its files. person is never given by path: it is the label tier:person, set by hand. Globs are matched against the whole path from the repository root: ** any number of folders, * and ? within one name, {a,b} either.

rules.why: documents nothing runs; AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md are left light, since every agent session follows them
tests and the data they read change no shipped behaviour; a test under a deep path stays deep, as it guards that boundary
how the UI looks, not what it does; copy inside .tsx is light, since a path cannot tell copy from logic
the store and its migrations: a step runs once on every person's data, and must not break the build still serving during a swap
the trust boundaries as written: later trust decisions are checked against this text
which tools a session has, when the person is asked, project trust, app secrets and capabilities, and path containment (docs/security-boundaries.md)
who may talk to the host (tokens, proofs, origins) and what an app view may load
the desktop commands the webview may call and its CSP, with the guards that hold them
starting, keeping, swapping, updating and stopping hosts and agents, here and on linked machines (keeper, shell, centralu serve, links): bugs show only in the real environment
signed content, releases and updates: what reaches every person's machine, and how it is checked there
messages between UI, host and linked machines of different versions: additions only, and a mistake reaches every pair
what CI runs and may skip, and the checks, merge queue and release tools that land and publish: a loosened gate lets every later change through
these rules and the code that reads them decide how much review every later change gets
